title: Nailed to the King
setup: Black's rook on e6 stands on the light diagonal that ends at its own king on g8.
hint: Your bishop wants a square where the rook in front of it has nowhere left to run. Which line ends on g8?
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook on **e6** and the king on **g8** share the a2–g8 diagonal. {{Bd5}} steps onto it, and the rook is pinned: moving it would expose the king, which is illegal. Nothing defends e6 either, so the rook is simply collected next move.
